integrity: The Foster--Pixley coordinate normal form gives an inclusion--exclusion embedding count; quotienting by the exactly determined domain automorphism group yields the r-Whitney formula. A concrete two-element Mal'cev algebra and symbolic descriptor families are exhaustively replayed.
scientific_limitations: Only subalgebras isomorphic to direct powers of the fixed simple algebra are counted; other subalgebras of a power may exist.
For groups the resulting numbers are the classical Dowling Whitney numbers, so closely related diagonal-subgroup descriptions may be folklore.
The result is an enumerative corollary of the Foster--Pixley normal form rather than a strengthening of the source's amalgamation theorem.
title: The finite-power K-substructure profile of a simple Mal'cev algebra is an r-Whitney triangle
